title: PROPERTY_USAGE_KEYING_INCREMENTS does not work without also the hframes and vframes properties
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8129) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900XT 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory

### Issue description

PROPERTY_USAGE_KEYING_INCREMENTS does not work without also the hframes and vframes properties. This is because the editor code checks for those properties when incrementing the value.

```
if (int64_t(object->get(property)) + 1 < (int64_t(object->get("hframes")) * int64_t(object->get("vframes")))) {
						callable_mp(this, &EditorProperty::emit_changed).call_deferred(property, object->get(property).operator int64_t() + 1, "", false);
					}
```
from editor_inspector.cpp 1111

### Steps to reproduce

1. create a script with an export variable with PROPERTY_USAGE_KEYING_INCREMENTS flag
2. make animationplayer track
3. press the key button on the variable
4. observe the value not changing

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24416765/test.zip)
